en: A black‑and‑white image of an ornate villa or spa building in a landscaped park. The main structure has decorative wooden trim, a round central window, French doors, balconies with railings, and attached wings extending into the garden. Mature trees, manicured shrubs, and curved walking paths surround the building. Several people in late‑19th‑ to early‑20th‑century clothing sit on benches or walk along the paths; one man sits in a wicker beach or garden chair in the left foreground. The scene has a relaxed, resort‑like atmosphere. A faint handwritten caption or numbering appears at the very bottom of the image.
